Chairperson.name: set_agenda_and_distribute_draft
Chairperson.description: Opens a new negotiation round at this table: finds the delegates seated at the table (same group_id), and sends them the draft, the clause list, the speaking order, the previous round's summary and the chair's compromise proposals. If the table has already concluded, or cannot open, it closes the step immediately.

required_variables.name: draft_content
required_variables.description: Full text of the draft agreement.

required_variables.name: clause_ids
required_variables.description: Clause identifiers that every position must use.

required_variables.name: agenda_items
required_variables.description: Agenda lines, each starting with its clause identifier.

required_variables.name: max_rounds
required_variables.description: Number of negotiation rounds before an impasse is declared.

output_updates.name: current_round
output_updates.description: Round now under way at this table.

Chairperson.name: collect_positions_and_divergences
Chairperson.condition: A proposal has arrived from every delegate at the table for the current round
Chairperson.description: Collects each delegate's move and end-of-turn positions, tallies Support / Conditional Support / Oppose / Unspecified per clause, and marks a clause unsettled if anyone opposes it or gave no position. No LLM call.

required_variables.name: delegate_proposals
required_variables.description: One AmendmentProposedEvent per delegate at the table.

output_updates.name: open_divergence_count
output_updates.description: Number of unsettled clauses after the tally.

Chairperson.name: determine_outcome
Chairperson.condition: All proposals of the round have been tallied
Chairperson.description: Applies the fixed outcome rule: all clauses settled -> consensus; clauses unsettled after the last round -> impasse; otherwise adjourn to the next round. The chair (LLM) flags settled-looking clauses whose conditions conflict, proposes compromise wording for unsettled clauses, and summarises the round.

required_variables.name: unsettled_clauses
required_variables.description: Clauses someone opposes or left unspecified.

Chairperson.name: issue_agreed_text
Chairperson.description: Drafts the final agreed text from the original draft, the amendments and the conditions behind the final positions, then ends the negotiation at this table.

required_variables.name: final_accepted_positions
required_variables.description: Support or Conditional Support per clause.

required_variables.name: accepted_amendments
required_variables.description: Proposals on the table in the final round.

Chairperson.name: declare_impasse
Chairperson.condition: Clauses are still unsettled after the last round
Chairperson.description: Writes a formal impasse record (position distribution, reasons, stated willingness to concede) and ends the negotiation at this table.

required_variables.name: concession_willingness_status
required_variables.description: Each delegate's stated willingness to concede further.

Delegate.name: review_draft_and_form_position
Delegate.condition: Draft received for a new round
Delegate.description: Reviews the draft (and, after round 1, the chair's summary and compromise proposals) and states Support / Conditional Support / Oppose on every clause, with the condition behind each Conditional Support.

required_variables.name: national_interests
required_variables.description: Country's interests on emission reduction and climate finance (private profile field).

Delegate.name: propose_amendment_or_concession
Delegate.condition: Own positions formed AND the proposals of every earlier speaker in this round received
Delegate.description: Speaks in turn: proposes an amendment, endorses an earlier speaker's proposal, or makes a concession; reports end-of-turn positions and whether further concessions would be considered. Sends the proposal to the chair and the accumulated proposals to the next speaker.

required_variables.name: clause_positions
required_variables.description: Own positions from the review step.

required_variables.name: prior_amendments
required_variables.description: Proposals of delegates who spoke earlier in this round (empty for the first speaker).

output_updates.name: clause_positions
output_updates.description: Positions at the end of the delegate's turn.

output_updates.name: willing_to_concede
output_updates.description: Stated willingness to make further concessions later.

output_updates.name: positions_changed_last_round
output_updates.description: Clauses whose position changed since the previous round.
